snippet.title: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - The Well of Dreams | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The final chapter of the Verminous Dreams adventure is here!

The Well of Dreams is an all new, free mission that concludes the three-part adventure - and it's available to play right now! 

The update also brings Quality of Life improvements and the annual Skulls for the Skull Throne event - so get in there and harvest some skulls! 

Learn more here:
► https://fatshark.games/aEyEIA
